name: Recovered-heat share of connected buildings' heat
Seasonal load factor of the heat-recovery interface
Levelised cost of network heat (system)
formula: (CAPEX x CRF + O&M + electricity incl. source side) / Q_network

name: Annual net economic value (system, vs today)
formula: baseline cost of served demand - (annualised CAPEX + O&M + electricity + backup fuel)

name: External funding needed by the network operator
formula: max(0, -(tariff + connection - fence payments - operator capex x CRF - network O&M))

name: Net CO2 avoided (LL97 factors)
formula: baseline CO2 of served demand - (electricity x 0.289 + backup fuel x EF)

name: On-site gas combustion displaced
formula: sum over gas buildings of (baseline fuel of served demand - backup fuel)

name: Low-income households benefited
formula: NYCHA / DAC apartments connected (rebuild: replacement + new affordable share)

name: NYCHA heating-cost change per apartment
formula: NYCHA users' net value / NYCHA apartments (0 when none connected)

name: Share of network heat delivered to low-income / DAC buildings
formula: 100 x Q_network(NYCHA or DAC buildings) / Q_network

name: Community facilities served
formula: number of connected schools, universities, museums, care facilities
